guia.pendCont: measure the {{n}} points with the milliohmmeter (on the right).
guia.pendMalha: drive the stakes, record P at 52%, 62% and 72% and click Calculate.
guia.pendTP: measure the {{n}} touch and step points.
guia.loteDetalhe: Nulls the leads or places the stakes automatically; keeps the soil, faults and C distance.

toggle.nomes: Show names and values in the scene
toggle.malha: Show buried grid (ring, cross conductors and ground rods)

cont.garraFixa: Fixed clamp on the skid main bonding bar
cont.compense: Zero the leads before measuring — otherwise the cables are included in the reading.
cont.criterio: Adopted criterion: ≤ {{a}} Ω pass · ≤ {{b}} Ω caution

terr.multiplo: ≈ {{k}}× the grid diagonal ({{d}} m). Changing the distance re-drives the stakes and clears the curve.
terr.zona: Grid zone of influence along the road: ~{{z}} m from E (potential above 10% of GPR, amber band in 3D).
terr.zonaFora: P at 52% is already outside it.
terr.zonaDentro: P at 52% still falls inside it — the curve will not flatten.
terr.cravar: Drive C and P stakes · connect E
terr.patamarRegistrado: Plateau recorded — calculate, or record more points to see the whole curve.
terr.registreMin: Record at least P at 52%, 62% and 72% to check the plateau.
terr.patamarOk: Stable plateau: the reading represents the grid. Adopted criterion ≤ {{l}} Ω.
terr.semPatamar: No plateau: the C stake is inside the grid zone of influence. Move it farther away and repeat.
terr.graficoVazio: move the P stake and record the points

tp.intro: Injection of {{it}} A into the grid; reading extrapolated to {{im}} A of fault current (t = {{t}} s). Soil {{rho}} Ω·m · crushed rock {{rb}} Ω·m, {{h}} cm.
tp.aviso: Limits from the NBR 15751 / IEEE 80 equations (50 kg body). Fault values belong to the teaching scenario.

toque.fail: Touch voltage above the tolerable limit

passo.fail: Step voltage above the tolerable limit

veredito.marginal: Within the limit, with little margin

mapa.textoRelevo: The relief height is the soil potential: the “plateau” is the grid at GPR; the slope outside the fence is where step and touch grow.
mapa.textoPotencial: Surface potential during the fault. Touch = GPR − potential under the feet: where the soil is “cold” (blue) near a grounded metal part, touch voltage is high.
mapa.segOk: ■ touch and step within the limit
mapa.segToque: ■ touch above the limit (if a metal part is within reach)
mapa.segNota: Limits with crushed rock at the skid/transformer and grass elsewhere.

laudo.resumoMalha: C stake at {{d}} m · plateau variation {{v}}% ({{estado}}).
laudo.rgRef: Calculated grid Rg (method of moments, {{rho}} Ω·m soil): {{rg}} Ω.
laudo.naoConforme: Grounding does not meet the criteria
laudo.parecerIncompleto: INCOMPLETE inspection: complete the three tests (continuity, grid resistance and touch/step) before issuing the report.
laudo.parecerConforme: The plant grounding system MEETS the adopted criteria: continuous bonding at all {{n}} points, grid at {{r}} Ω with a stable plateau, and touch and step voltages below the tolerable limits.
laudo.parecerNaoConforme: {{n}} finding(s) were identified. The grounding system DOES NOT MEET the adopted criteria until the items listed are corrected and the tests are repeated.

rodape.didatico: Teaching simulation result — not a report on a real installation

acao.cont-aberto: Locate the break (missing or broken braid/bonding lead), repair it and measure again.
acao.cont-refazer-conexao: Remake the connection with a serrated washer/clamp that pierces the anodizing and measure again.
acao.cont-reapertar: Clean, treat and retighten the connector; measure again.
acao.malha-sem-patamar: No plateau: move the current stake farther away (≥ 5× the grid diagonal) and repeat the curve.
acao.malha-alta: Extend the grid, add ground rods or treat the soil; re-evaluate touch and step.
acao.tp-portao: Rebuild the equipotential bonding ring in front of the gate (1 m from the fence) and re-evaluate; in very high-resistivity soil, add crushed rock outside.
acao.tp-reforcar: Reinforce the grid at that location, apply crushed rock (≥ 10 cm) and re-evaluate.

instrutor.notaCondicao: Changing the condition clears all measurements.
instrutor.notaSolo: The soil changes the grid: it clears the curve and touch/step (continuity is kept).

mesa.dica: Table bonding lead to the grid, jumpers between profiles and clamps with serrated washers.

m4.dica: Grounding clamp on an anodized profile: without a serrated washer, the anodizing insulates.

m6.dica: Bonding lead connector exposed to moisture — look for oxidation and check tightness.

inversores.dica: PE conductor from each inverter to the skid ground bus.

trafo.dica: Tank and LV neutral bonded to the grid at separate points; no broken braid.

se.ate: Ground bar of the metering and protection cubicle
se.dica: Substation grid bonded to the plant grid — no separate grids on the same site.

portao.dica: The moving leaf needs a flexible braid to the grounded post — the hinge does not conduct.

cerca-no.dica: Metal fence grounded at intervals and at the corners, bonded to the equipotential bonding ring.

t-trafo.local: Hand on the tank, feet 1 m away on the crushed rock
t-trafo.dica: Critical point: an MV fault at the transformer raises the potential of the whole grid.

t-skid.nome: Touch — main LV switchboard door on the skid
t-skid.local: Hand on the metal door, feet on the crushed rock
t-skid.dica: Metal doors and panels at the same potential as the grid.

t-mesa.local: Hand on the table post, feet on the grass
t-mesa.dica: The grid cross conductor under the row reduces the difference between structure and soil.

t-portao.local: Hand on the gate, feet outside the fence, on the grass
t-portao.dica: Outside the fence there is no crushed rock or grid under the feet: the equipotential bonding ring 1 m out is what holds up the soil potential. With the section in front of the gate interrupted, touch voltage rises.

p-trafo.nome: Step — next to the transformer base
p-trafo.local: Feet 1 m apart, on the crushed rock
p-trafo.dica: The crushed rock layer raises the foot contact resistance.

p-cerca.local: Feet 1 m apart, outside the fence, on the grass
p-cerca.dica: The potential gradient is highest at the edge of the grid.
